method: Transcribed from rendered matrix CSS percentages through computer use; numeric hand details spot-checked. Conditional frequencies in units of 0.01 percentage points. Rounded row totals can differ from 10000 by up to 2; normalize each row when applying it. An absent hand row was empty in the source matrix.
coverage: 203 retained matrices (85 in 6-max, 118 in 8-max), collected on 2026-09-09 through 2026-09-11. All opening and facing-open positions in both formats; BB versus SB limps and standard limp/raise/reraise lines including direct all-ins; every opener versus standard BB and SB 3-bets followed by the standard 4-bet/5-bet/all-in line (other players fold); direct 4-bet/5-bet shoves against BB and all 6-max SB 3-bets, plus 8-max BTN versus SB and CO direct 4-bet shove; BB after BTN open/SB cold call. Other histories are unavailable, including non-blind 3-bets, additional cold-call/squeeze and early all-in branches, and remaining 8-max direct shoves against SB. The third session added 68 matrices and stopped at the account daily limit of 100/100.

validation.notes: All captured action totals checked against the displayed weighted-combo totals. Source hides a few tiny incoming hands at later nodes; consumers retain only hands with a displayed strategy when that seat acts.
